goal: Document the current Ecology author guidelines and produce a reviewable Ecology-formatted proof of the FAIR + CARE manuscript without representing it as submission-ready.

actor.version: exact deployment version not exposed to the repository

compute.environment: owner-authorized local Codex workspace with repository-scoped write access
compute.data_boundary: public repository content, public institutional author information, and public journal guidance only; no research, governed, or sensitive data
compute.network: read-only retrieval of official Ecology, Ecological Society of America, and public institutional web pages; local loopback server used for website tests

instructions: PROMPT_LOG.md entry: Apply Ecology author guidelines
official Ecology Author Guidelines, revised April 2026
inputs: Ecological Society of America Open Research Policy
outputs: synchronized repository, website, CI, and release-gate documentation
evaluations: official-source comparison and manual guideline transcription review
PDF structural checks for page size, ordering, metadata, empty pages, and glyph extraction
visual inspection of all 16 rendered pages
strict website build and Playwright link and interaction tests

human_review.notes: The proof awaits author confirmation, journal invitation or proposal acceptance, conflict/funding/contribution declarations, finished figure artwork, permanent archival identifier, external scholarly and Indigenous data sovereignty review, and conversion to a Word or genuine LaTeX Main Document.
